literature.headline_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期乙型肝炎病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 抗病毒药物治疗与改善长期生存率相关,但在HBV相关HCC中仍被低估使用。 [10.1111/jvh.70245]

在第28天,30 mg BID 28天组的HBsAg水平下降了−0.65 log10 IU/mL,而60 mg BID 28天组的下降为−0.53 log10 IU/mL。30 mg BID 12周组在治疗结束时相较于安慰剂组显示出更大的下降,−0.89 log10 IU/mL。值得注意的是,12周组中有76.5%的患者实现了HBsAg低于100 IU/mL。 [10.1111/liv.70918]
HBV感染合并肝脂肪变的患者表现出较低的病毒载量和几种细胞因子及趋化因子的血浆水平降低,包括IL-2、IL-9、IL-15、IL-18、CCL2、CCL4和CXCL10,以及氨基转移酶水平降低。其他细胞因子在两组之间没有显著差异。 [10.1093/infdis/jiag281]
对preS结构域的氨基酸分析显示存在广泛的变异,包括47.7%(21/44)的菌株中出现的G133E 突变,以及在第117和120位残基中与基因型相关的取代。遗传特征分析显示仅存在基因型I和II(DHBV-I和DHBV-II)的特异性传播,未检测到与西方相关的DHBV-III。鉴定了20个重组事件,其中6个涉及本研究序列作为亲本株。 [10.1016/j.virol.2026.111101]
涵盖范围包括核苷(酸)类似物和聚乙二醇干扰素-α、HBsAg引导的路线图、有限的NA疗法和非治疗结果、贝皮罗韦森、其他病毒靶向和免疫调节剂以及基因组导向的共价闭合环状DNA沉默和编辑。 [10.1080/14787210.2026.2749497]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: Antiviral therapy is associated with improved long-term survival but remains underutilized in HBV-related HCC. [10.1111/jvh.70245]

At Day 28, HBsAg reductions were −0.65 log10 IU/mL in the 30 mg BID 28-day group and −0.53 log10 IU/mL in the 60 mg BID 28-day group. The 30 mg BID 12-week group showed a greater reduction of −0.89 log10 IU/mL at the end of treatment versus placebo. [10.1111/liv.70918]

Patients with HBV infection and liver steatosis had a lower viral load and reduced plasma levels of several cytokines and chemokines, including IL-2, IL-9, IL-15, IL-18, CCL2, CCL4, and CXCL10, as well as reduced aminotransferase levels. Other cytokines did not significantly differ between the groups. [10.1093/infdis/jiag281]

The overall pooled prevalence was 13.0% for HBV and 8.0% for HCV among prisoners. Significant regional disparities were observed, with West Africa presenting the highest HBV burden (16.3%) and East Africa showing the highest HCV burden (8.8%). [10.1177/23259582261494741]

Amino acid analysis of the preS domain showed extensive variability, including the G133E mutation in 47.7% (21/44) of strains and genotype-associated substitutions at residues 117 and 120. [10.1016/j.virol.2026.111101]

papers.title: Safety, Tolerability and Antiviral Activity of GST ‐ HG131 in Chronic Hepatitis B: A Randomized, Double‐Blind Phase IIa Study
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Background and Aims Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) remains a major global health burden. Current therapies rarely achieve a functional cure due to low rates of HBsAg clearance, the persistence of the viral replication template—covalently closed circular DNA (cccDNA)—and the need for lifelong treatment. GST‐HG131 is a first‐in‐class, orally bioavailable small‐molecule inhibitor of PAPD5/7, key host factors involved in HBV mRNA stabilization and HBsAg production. We evaluated the safety, tolerability and antiviral activity of GST‐HG131 in patients with CHB receiving nucleos(t)ide analogue (NUC) therapy in a randomized, double‐blind, placebo‐controlled Phase IIa study. Methods This double‐blind, randomized, placebo‐controlled Phase IIa study evaluated the efficacy and safety of GST‐HG131 in 45 CHB patients. Cohorts 1 and 2 ( n = 10 each; 8 active, 2 placebo) received 30 mg or 60 mg BID for 28 days, respectively. Cohort 3 ( n = 25; 20 active, five placebo) received 30 mg BID for 12 weeks. All participants were on nucleos(t)ide analog monotherapy for more than 6 months, with HBsAg between 100 and 1500 IU/mL, and serum ALT below 1× ULN. Results At Day 28, HBsAg reductions were −0.65 log 10 IU/mL in the 30 mg BID 28‐day group and −0.53 log 10 IU/mL in the 60 mg BID 28‐day group. The 30 mg BID 12‐week group showed a greater reduction of −0.89 log 10 IU/mL at the end of treatment versus placebo ( p 50% reduction in HBsAg with a maximum decrease of 1.64 log 10 IU/mL. Notably, 76.5% of patients in the 12‐week group achieved HBsAg below 100 IU/mL. Rebounds in HBsAg were observed following treatment discontinuation. GST‐HG131 was well tolerated, with no dose‐related toxicity or emerging safety concerns across all cohorts. Conclusion GST‐HG131, a first‐in‐class oral PAPD5/7 inhibitor, demonstrated favourable safety and significant HBsAg reduction in patients with CHB. The greatest antiviral activity was observed after 12 weeks of treatment, supporting further clinical development of GST‐HG131 as a component of functional cure strategies for CHB. Trial Registration ClinicalTrials.gov identifier: NCT06263959

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景与目的 慢性乙型肝炎(慢性乙型肝炎,CHB)仍然是一个重大的全球健康负担。当前的治疗方法由于HBsAg清除率低、病毒复制模板——共价闭合环状DNA(共价闭合环状DNA)的持续存在以及需要终生治疗,很少能达到功能性治愈。GST‐HG131是一种第一类口服小分子PAPD5/7抑制剂,PAPD5/7是HBV mRNA稳定和HBsAg生成的关键因子。我们评估了GST‐HG131在使用核苷(酸)类似物(NUC)治疗的CHB患者中的安全性和耐受性及抗病毒药物活性,在一项随机、双盲、安慰剂对照的Phase IIa研究中进行了研究。方法 这是一项随机、双盲、安慰剂对照的Phase IIa研究,评估了GST‐HG131在45例CHB患者中的疗效和安全性。队列研究 1和2(每组10例;8例活性药物,2例安慰剂)分别接受30 mg或60 mg BID,共28天。队列研究 3(25例;20例活性药物,5例安慰剂)接受30 mg BID,共12周。所有参与者均接受核苷(酸)类似物单药治疗超过6个月,HBsAg在100至1500 IU/mL之间,血清ALT低于1×ULN。结果 在第28天,30 mg BID 28天组的HBsAg减少为−0.65 log10 IU/mL,60 mg BID 28天组的HBsAg减少为−0.53 log10 IU/mL。12周的30 mg BID组在治疗结束时的HBsAg减少更为显著,为−0.89 log10 IU/mL,与安慰剂组相比(p<0.05),实现了50%以上的HBsAg减少,最大减少为1.64 log10 IU/mL。值得注意的是,12周组中有76.5%的患者实现了HBsAg低于100 IU/mL。在治疗停药后观察到HBsAg反弹。GST‐HG131耐受性良好,未出现剂量相关毒性或新的安全问题。结论 GST‐HG131,一种第一类口服PAPD5/7抑制剂,在CHB患者中表现出良好的安全性和显著的HBsAg减少。抗病毒药物活性在12周的治疗后达到最大,支持GST‐HG131作为CHB治疗策略组成部分的进一步临床开发。临床试验注册 ClinicalTrials.gov标识符:NCT06263959

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)仍是全球主要的健康负担。由于HBsAg清除率低、病毒复制模板——共价闭合环状DNA(共价闭合环状DNA)持续存在以及需要终身治疗,现有疗法很少能实现功能性治愈。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项随机、双盲、安慰剂对照的IIa期研究评估了GST-HG131在45名慢性乙型肝炎患者中的疗效和安全性。所有参与者均接受核苷(酸)类似物单药治疗超过6个月,HBsAg水平在100至1500 IU/mL之间,血清ALT低于1× ULN。
analysis_zh.methods: 研究评估了接受核苷(酸)类似物(NUC)治疗的慢性乙型肝炎患者中GST-HG131的安全性、耐受性和功能性治愈活性。组1和组2(各10名患者;8名接受治疗,2名安慰剂)分别接受了30 mg或60 mg每日两次(BID)治疗28天。组3(25名患者;20名接受治疗,5名安慰剂)接受了30 mg BID治疗12周。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在第28天,30 mg BID 28天组的HBsAg水平下降了−0.65 log10 IU/mL,而60 mg BID 28天组的下降为−0.53 log10 IU/mL。30 mg BID 12周组在治疗结束时相较于安慰剂组显示出更大的下降,−0.89 log10 IU/mL。值得注意的是,12周组中有76.5%的患者实现了HBsAg低于100 IU/mL。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究显示,GST-HG131作为一种第一类口服PAPD5/7抑制剂,显著降低了慢性乙型肝炎患者的HBsAg水平。在12周治疗后观察到最大的功能性治愈活性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现支持GST-HG131作为慢性乙型肝炎功能性治愈策略的一部分的潜力。它们可能为未来关于HBV治疗的研究提供信息,并有助于开发更有效的疗法。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究样本量较小且治疗时间较短。证据强度中等,因为它是基于IIa期试验,且没有长期随访数据。

papers.title: Global Underutilization of Antiviral Therapy and Survival Outcomes in Hepatitis B Virus‐Related Hepatocellular Carcinoma: A Systematic Review and Meta‐Analysis of 78 Studies and 68,243 Patients
papers.abstract: Antiviral therapy with nucleos(t)ide analogues is recommended for patients with viremic hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related cirrhosis regardless of levels of viremia or liver enzymes. However, hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is not an antiviral treatment criterion in the U.S. HBV treatment guidelines, though prior studies have reported improved survival with antiviral treatment in HBV-related HCC. To inform guidelines, we estimated antiviral treatment rates and their association with survival and HCC recurrence rates in HBV-related HCC. We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis of studies published between 2006 and 2024 that reported antiviral treatment, survival, and/or HCC recurrence rates in adults with HBV-related HCC, following PRISMA guidelines. Random-effects models pooled study estimates. Of the initial 4556 studies, 178 underwent full-text review, and 78 (68,243 patients) were analysed. The pooled antiviral treatment rate (52 studies, 41,345 patients) was 53.1%. In studies reporting pre-HCC antiviral initiation, 17.2% of HBV-related HCC patients received therapy before diagnosis. Treated (vs untreated) patients had higher 3- and 5-year OS (80.4% vs. 46.8%, both p < 0.01). Five-year OS was 78.0% vs. 56.4% in inactive HCC (p < 0.01) and 48.2% vs. 22.6% in active HCC (p = 0.14). Antiviral therapy remained independently associated with improved 5-year OS in multivariable meta-regression. There was no significant difference in HCC recurrence rates. Antiviral therapy is associated with improved long-term survival but remains underutilized in HBV-related HCC. These findings highlight a critical gap in care and underscore the need for earlier and more consistent antiviral initiation in patients with HBV-related HCC.

papers.abstract_zh: 使用核苷(酸)类似物进行抗病毒药物治疗被推荐用于所有具有病毒血症的乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)相关肝硬化的患者,无论其病毒载量或肝酶水平如何。然而,肝细胞癌(HCC)并不是美国HBV 治疗指南中的治疗标准。尽管之前的研究报告指出,在HBV相关HCC患者中,抗病毒药物治疗与改善生存率相关,但目前仍缺乏明确的指南。为了指导指南制定,我们估计了抗病毒药物治疗率及其与生存率和HCC复发率之间的关联。我们按照PRISMA指南,对2006年至2024年间发表的、报告了HBV相关HCC成人患者抗病毒药物治疗率、生存率和/或HCC复发率的研究进行了系统综述和荟萃分析。使用随机效应模型汇总研究估计值。初始共有4556项研究,其中178项进行了全文审查,最终分析了78项(共68,243名患者)。汇总的抗病毒药物治疗率(52项研究,41,345名患者)为53.1%。在报告了HCC前抗病毒药物治疗启动的研究中,17.2%的HBV相关HCC患者在HCC发生前接受了治疗。接受治疗(与未接受治疗相比)的患者3年和5年总生存率(OS)更高(80.4% vs. 46.8%,两者p < 0.01)。在非活动性HCC研究中,5年OS为78.0% vs. 56.4%(p < 0.01),而在活动性HCC研究中,5年OS为48.2% vs. 22.6%(p = 0.14)。在多变量荟萃回归分析中,抗病毒药物治疗仍与改善5年OS独立相关。HCC复发率没有显著差异。抗病毒药物治疗与改善长期生存率相关,但在HBV相关HCC中仍被低估使用。这些发现突显了护理中的关键差距,并强调了在HBV相关HCC患者中更早和更一致地启动抗病毒药物治疗的必要性。

papers.title: Hepatitis B and C Virus Among Prisoners in Sub-Saharan Africa: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
papers.abstract: ObjectiveTo estimate the pooled prevalence and identify transmission drivers of hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis C virus (HCV) infections among incarcerated populations in sub-Saharan Africa.MethodsA systematic review and meta-analysis was conducted following a search encompassing Medical Subject Headings (MeSH) and free-text terms from database inception through February 2025. Data were synthesized from 26 studies involving 77,760 prisoners across sub-Saharan Africa. A random-effects model was used to calculate pooled prevalence estimates, assess regional variation, and evaluate odds ratios (OR) for potential transmission risk factors.ResultsThe overall pooled prevalence was 13.0% for HBV and 8.0% for HCV among prisoners. Significant regional disparities were observed, with West Africa presenting the highest HBV burden (16.3%) and East Africa showing the highest HCV burden (8.8%). Key independent predictors of infection included sharing sharp objects (OR, 1.98), tattooing (OR, 1.92), and intravenous drug use (OR, 1.38).ConclusionIncarcerated populations in sub-Saharan Africa experience a high burden of viral hepatitis driven by parenteral exposure and high-risk sexual interactions. Addressing these gaps requires targeted screening, comprehensive harm reduction, condom provision, and integrating prison health services into national elimination strategies.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to estimate the pooled prevalence and identify transmission drivers of hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis C virus (HCV) infections among incarcerated populations in sub-Saharan Africa. papers.title: Evaluating the potential of treatment options for chronic hepatitis B
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) remains a leading cause of cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma worldwide, but long-term or even lifelong viral suppression with nucleos(t)ide analogues (NAs) seldom clears hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg), so-called 'functional cure.' In recent years, a shift in treatment strategy from viral suppression toward cure has emerged, catalyzed by three revised international hepatitis B guidelines (2025-2026) and the first-in-class phase 3 evidence that a finite antiviral therapy, the antisense oligonucleotide bepirovirsen, can achieve a functional cure in about one in five NA-suppressed CHB patients with baseline HBsAg below 3000 IU/mL. AREAS COVERED: We evaluated the spectrum of established and emerging treatment options for CHB, organized around quantitative HBsAg (qHBsAg) as the axis for selecting and sequencing therapy. Coverage spans backbone NAs and pegylated interferon-α, an HBsAg-guided roadmap, finite NA therapy and off-treatment outcomes, bepirovirsen, other virus-targeting and immunomodulatory agents, and genome-directed covalently closed circular DNA silencing and editing. EXPERT OPINION: Bepirovirsen's approaching approval is an inflection point. qHBsAg should guide personalized, sequential therapy, with partial cure (HBsAg < 100 IU/mL) as a potential intermediate target when functional cure is unlikely. Durability, standardized biomarkers, rational combination design, metabolic co-management and equitable access are the priorities; a sterilizing cure remains distant.

papers.title: Burden of liver fibrosis and steatosis coexisting with hepatitis B or C infection in China: a population-based study from the 2020 National Serological Survey.
papers.abstract: Background The burden of liver fibrosis and steatosis coexisting with hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis C virus (HCV) infections in China remains to be quantified. Objective To estimate the prevalence of HBV or HCV infection with liver fibrosis and steatosis to inform national elimination strategies. Design This study was conducted among individuals aged 15–69 years in the 2020 National Serological Survey of Viral Hepatitis in China. Among participants with HBV or HCV infection, liver fibrosis and steatosis were assessed using vibration-controlled transient elastography. Weighted prevalence and population estimates of HBV or HCV infection coexisting with liver fibrosis and steatosis were calculated. Results Among 69 351 participants, 4236 had HBV infection and 122 had HCV infection. The weighted population prevalence of HBV and HCV infection with ≥F2 fibrosis was 0.63% (95% CI 0.52% to 0.77%) and 0.05% (95% CI 0.03% to 0.08%), accounting for an estimated 6.08 million and 0.48 million individuals in China, respectively. The corresponding prevalence of steatosis was 1.82% (95% CI 1.56% to 2.13%) and 0.06% (95% CI 0.04% to 0.10%), accounting for an estimated 17.30 million and 0.61 million individuals respectively. Diagnosis rates were 59.78% for HBV infection and 38.02% for HCV infection, and treatment rates were 7.60% and 48.66% respectively. Conclusion China continues to face a substantial burden of advanced liver disease among people with viral hepatitis, further compounded by the high prevalence of liver steatosis. analysis.summary_en: Using data from the 2020 National Serological Survey of Viral Hepatitis in China, this population‐based study estimated the prevalence of HBV and HCV infection coexisting with liver fibrosis (stage ≥F2) and steatosis among 69,351 adults aged 15–69 years. Among 4,236 HBV‐positive and 122 HCV‐positive participants, the weighted prevalence of advanced fibrosis was 0.63% (95% CI 0.52%–0.77%) for HBV and 0.05% (95% CI 0.03%–0.08%) for HCV, representing roughly 6.08 million and 0.48 million people, respectively. Liver steatosis was present in 1.82% (95% CI 1.56%–2.13%) of HBV‐infected and 0.06% (95% CI 0.04%–0.10%) of HCV‐infected individuals, corresponding to about 17.30 million and 0.61 million persons. Diagnosis rates were 59.8% for HBV and 38.0% for HCV, with treatment rates of 7.6% and 48.7%, respectively. The authors conclude that China faces a substantial burden of advanced liver disease among those with viral hepatitis, underscoring the urgent need for proactive case‐finding and improved linkage to care to achieve hepatitis elimination.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:在中国,肝纤维化和脂肪变性共存于乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)和丙型肝炎病毒(HCV)感染中的负担尚未量化。目的:估计HBV或HCV感染伴肝纤维化和脂肪变性的患病率,以为国家消除策略提供信息。设计:本研究在2020年中国病毒性肝炎全国血清学调查中,对年龄15–69岁的个体进行。对HBV或HCV感染的参与者,使用振动控制瞬时弹性成像评估肝纤维化和脂肪变性。计算了HBV或HCV感染共存肝纤维化和脂肪变性的加权患病率及人口估计。结果:在69 351名参与者中,4236例为HBV感染,122例为HCV感染。HBV和HCV感染伴≥F2纤维化的加权人口患病率分别为0.63%(95% CI 0.52%至0.77%)和0.05%(95% CI 0.03%至0.08%),对应估计的6.08 million和0.48 million个体。相应的脂肪变性患病率为1.82%(95% CI 1.56%至2.13%)和0.06%(95% CI 0.04%至0.10%),对应估计的17.30 million和0.61 million个体。诊断率分别为HBV感染的59.78%和HCV感染的38.02%,治疗率分别为7.60%和48.66%。结论:中国继续面临病毒性肝炎患者中大量晚期肝病负担,且肝脂肪变性的高患病率进一步加重。积极的病例发现和护理链接对于实现将病毒性肝炎消除为公共卫生威胁至关重要。

papers.title: Finite Versus Indefinite Nucleos(t)ide Analogue Therapy in HBeAg‐Negative Chronic Hepatitis B: Meta‐Analysis of Randomized Trials.
papers.abstract: Continuous nucleos(t)ide analogue (NA) therapy for chronic hepatitis B (CHB) effectively maintains viral suppression but rarely results in functional cure. Finite NA therapy has been proposed to increase rates of HBsAg loss; however, international guidelines provide conflicting recommendations. This study compares the efficacy and safety of finite versus continuous NA therapy in HBeAg-negative adults using randomized controlled trials. We included parallel-group randomized controlled trials (RCTs) comparing nucleos(t)ide analogue (NA) cessation versus continuation in non-cirrhotic, virally suppressed HBeAg-negative adults. Two reviewers independently screened studies and assessed risk of bias using Cochrane RoB 2. Random-effects Mantel-Haenszel meta-analyses with Hartung-Knapp adjustment and Paule-Mandel estimation were used to pool risk ratios (RRs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs). Certainty of evidence was assessed using the GRADE approach. Four RCTs (n = 357) met inclusion criteria. Discontinuation increased HBsAg loss vs. continuation (RR 5.02, 95% CI: 0.47-53.47; I2 = 21.8%; low certainty), corresponding to ~53 additional losses per 1000 patients. However, finite therapy markedly increased virologic relapse (RR 23.09) and retreatment (RR 21.94) while reducing sustained off-therapy virologic response (RR 0.46). Post-cessation ALT flares were frequent but self-limited or resolved with retreatment. No hepatic decompensation or serious adverse events occurred. In monitored, non-cirrhotic adults, finite NA therapy may increase the probability of HBsAg loss despite predictable relapse and retreatment. With no evidence of severe harm, these findings support finite therapy as a selective, patient-centered strategy toward functional cure in expert centers.

papers.title: Prevalence and Associated Factors of Hepatitis B and/or C Virus Infections among Medical Waste Handlers in Ethiopia: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
papers.abstract: Health systems around the world are severely impacted by hepatitis B Virus and hepatitis C Virus, particularly in low- and middle-income nations. These viruses are still more common in Ethiopia even with preventive efforts including the hepatitis B vaccine, universal precautions, and occupational safety procedures. There is little information available on their frequency and related variables among Ethiopian medical waste handlers. The purpose of this meta-analysis and systematic review was to ascertain the prevalence of hepatitis B and/or C in this population as well as its contributing factors. Different databases, including PubMed, Science Direct, Cochrane, Hinari, Google Scholar, grey literature, and articles from different university repository sites, were examined in order to locate available publications. Five studies with a total sample size of 1,211 participants were included in this systematic review and meta-analysis. The data was extracted and sorted using Microsoft Excel version 13 before being sent to STATA/MP 17.0 for analysis. The Newcastle-Ottawa Scale was used to assess each study’s quality. The pooled prevalence of the hepatitis B and C virus was examined using a Der Simonian random-effects model with a 95% confidence interval. The Egger’s test and I 2 were used to evaluate publication bias and heterogeneity. The possible cause of heterogeneity was assessed using both subgroup analysis and meta-regression. P-values less than 0.05 were considered statistically significant. The pooled prevalence of hepatitis B and/or C viruses among Ethiopian medical waste handlers was 13% (95% CI: 5–21%), according to the findings of this comprehensive study and meta-analysis. Significant heterogeneity is shown in the Galbraith plot, with I 2 = 96.21% ( p < 0.001). The prevalence of hepatitis B and/or C viruses was 11.3%, according to studies conducted until the year 2020. However, studies included less than 260 participants found that the prevalence of the hepatitis B and/or C virus was 14.90%. This study found that having multiple sexual partners and prior exposure to sharp objects were associated with Hepatitis B Virus and/or Hepatitis C Virus infection among medical waste handlers. These findings highlight the role of behavioral and occupational factors in hepatitis transmission. Therefore, reducing infection risk requires promoting safe sexual practices and strengthening infection prevention and control measures in healthcare settings.

papers.abstract_zh: 全球卫生系统正受到乙型肝炎病毒和乙型肝炎病毒的严重冲击,尤其是在低收入和中等收入国家。即使有包括乙型肝炎病毒疫苗、普遍预防措施和职业安全程序在内的预防措施,这些病毒在埃塞俄比亚仍然较为常见。目前关于埃塞俄比亚医疗废物处理人员中这些病毒的流行率及其相关变量的信息仍然有限。本项系统综述和荟萃分析的目的是确定该人群中乙型和/或丙型肝炎的患病率及其影响因素。为了寻找相关文献,我们查阅了包括PubMed、Science Direct、Cochrane、Hinari、Google Scholar、灰色文献以及不同大学文献库在内的多个数据库。本系统综述和荟萃分析共纳入了五项研究,总样本量为1,211名参与者。数据使用Microsoft Excel版本13进行提取和整理,然后导入STATA/MP 17.0进行分析。采用Newcastle-Ottawa量表评估每项研究的质量。使用Der Simonian随机效应模型,结合95%置信区间,分析了乙型和丙型肝炎病毒的综合患病率。采用Egger检验和I 2检验评估发表偏倚和异质性。通过亚组分析和元回归评估异质性的可能原因。P值小于0.05被认为具有统计学意义。根据这项全面的研究和荟萃分析,埃塞俄比亚医疗废物处理人员中乙型和/或丙型肝炎病毒的综合患病率为13%(95% CI:5–21%)。Galbraith图显示存在显著异质性,I 2 = 96.21%(p < 0.001)。截至2020年的研究显示,乙型和/或丙型肝炎病毒的患病率为11.3%。然而,样本量少于260的研究发现,乙型和/或丙型肝炎病毒的患病率为14.90%。本研究发现,拥有多个性伴侣和之前接触尖锐物体与医疗废物处理人员中乙型肝炎病毒和/或丙型肝炎病毒的感染有关。这些发现突显了行为和职业因素在肝炎传播中的作用。因此,降低感染风险需要推广安全的性行为实践,并加强医疗保健环境中的感染预防和控制措施。

papers.title: Superior Efficacy of Besifovir in Reducing Hepatocellular Carcinoma Risk Compared to Tenofovir in Chronic Hepatitis B Patients: A Nationwide Cohort Study.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Besifovir dipivoxil maleate (BSV) is a novel therapeutic option for the treatment of chronic hepatitis B (CHB). However, its long-term effectiveness in reducing the risk of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) remains unclear. METHODS: We conducted a retrospective cohort study using the Korean Health Insurance Review and Assessment Service database from 2018 to 2022. A total of 32,383 patients with CHB were included (BSV, n = 2,358; tenofovir disoproxil fumarate [TDF], n = 30,025). Propensity score matching was conducted at a 1:3 ratio to minimize selection bias. The primary outcome was the incidence of HCC, with cirrhosis development as the secondary endpoint. RESULTS: In the overall population, 57 cases of HCC were reported in the BSV group (2,358 individuals, 5,918 person-years), while 1,268 cases of HCC were reported in the TDF group (30,025 individuals, 83,587 person-years). After propensity score matching, the incidence of HCC was significantly lower in the BSV group (9.63 per 1,000 person-years; 95% confidence interval [CI], 7.43-12.49) than in the TDF group (15.36 per 1,000 person-years; 95% CI, 13.72-17.18), with an incidence rate ratio of 1.59 (P = 0.001). This protective effect remained consistent in both cirrhotic (hazard ratio [HR], 1.609; P = 0.028) and non-cirrhotic subgroups (HR, 1.831; P = 0.002). CONCLUSION: BSV treatment demonstrated superior efficacy in reducing the risk of HCC compared to TDF, regardless of baseline cirrhosis status. These findings suggest that BSV may provide enhanced protection against HCC in patients with CHB.

source_records.title: Superior Efficacy of Besifovir in Reducing Hepatocellular Carcinoma Risk Compared to Tenofovir in Chronic Hepatitis B Patients: A Nationwide Cohort Study.
source_records.abstract: BACKGROUND Besifovir dipivoxil maleate (BSV) is a novel therapeutic option for the treatment of chronic hepatitis B (CHB). However, its long-term effectiveness in reducing the risk of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) remains unclear. METHODS We conducted a retrospective cohort study using the Korean Health Insurance Review and Assessment Service database from 2018 to 2022. A total of 32,383 patients with CHB were included (BSV, n = 2,358; tenofovir disoproxil fumarate [TDF], n = 30,025). Propensity score matching was conducted at a 1:3 ratio to minimize selection bias. The primary outcome was the incidence of HCC, with cirrhosis development as the secondary endpoint. RESULTS In the overall population, 57 cases of HCC were reported in the BSV group (2,358 individuals, 5,918 person-years), while 1,268 cases of HCC were reported in the TDF group (30,025 individuals, 83,587 person-years). After propensity score matching, the incidence of HCC was significantly lower in the BSV group (9.63 per 1,000 person-years; 95% confidence interval [CI], 7.43-12.49) than in the TDF group (15.36 per 1,000 person-years; 95% CI, 13.72-17.18), with an incidence rate ratio of 1.59 (P = 0.001). This protective effect remained consistent in both cirrhotic (hazard ratio [HR], 1.609; P = 0.028) and non-cirrhotic subgroups (HR, 1.831; P = 0.002). CONCLUSION BSV treatment demonstrated superior efficacy in reducing the risk of HCC compared to TDF, regardless of baseline cirrhosis status. These findings suggest that BSV may provide enhanced protection against HCC in patients with CHB.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:Besifovir二甲基马来酸盐(BSV)是慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)的一种新型治疗选择。然而,其在降低肝细胞癌(HCC)风险方面的长期效果仍不清楚。方法:我们使用韩国健康保险审查与评估服务数据库,从2018年至2022年进行了一项回顾性队列研究。共纳入32,383名CHB患者(BSV组,n = 2,358;替诺福韦二甲基苯甲酸酯[TDF]组,n = 30,025)。采用1:3的倾向评分匹配方法以减少选择偏倚。主要结局是HCC的发病率,而肝硬化的发展作为次要终点。结果:在总体人群中,BSV组报告了57例HCC(2,358人,5,918人年),而TDF组报告了1,268例HCC(30,025人,83,587人年)。倾向评分匹配后,BSV组的HCC发病率显著低于TDF组(BSV组为9.63例每1,000人年;95%置信区间[CI]为7.43-12.49),而TDF组为15.36例每1,000人年(95% CI为13.72-17.18),发病率比为1.59(P = 0.001)。这种保护作用在肝硬化(风险比[HR]为1.609;P = 0.028)和非肝硬化亚组(HR为1.831;P = 0.002)中均保持一致。结论:无论基线肝硬化状态如何,BSV在降低HCC风险方面均显示出优于TDF的疗效。这些发现表明,BSV可能为慢性乙型肝炎患者提供更强的HCC防护作用。

papers.title: Circulation and recombination-driven diversity of duck hepatitis B virus in domesticated geese in Guangdong, southern China
papers.abstract: Duck hepatitis B virus (DHBV) is a valuable comparative model for human hepatitis B virus (HBV) due to its shared genomic organization and reverse transcription-based replication, despite having only ∼40% nucleotide identity. Infection is generally asymptomatic in adult birds but causes reduced hatchability, impaired embryo development, and growth retardation in young waterfowl, leading to economic losses. As a major waterfowl producer, China faces risks from this endemic virus. This study analyzed 901 deceased domesticated geese liver samples from five regions in Guangdong province, southern China. Nested PCR screening revealed an overall infection prevalence of 34.1% (307/901). Amino acid analysis of the preS domain of the large envelope protein showed extensive variability, including the G133E mutation in 47.7% (21/44) of strains and genotype-associated substitutions at residues 117 and 120. Genetic characterization of 44 complete genomes revealed exclusive circulation of genotypes I and II (DHBV-I and DHBV-II), with no detection of the Western-associated DHBV-III. Phylogenetic analysis indicated frequent duck-goose host-switching and viral circulation between provinces, likely facilitated by the live-poultry trade. We identified 20 recombination events, six of which involved our sequences as parental strains, demonstrating that active recombination among co-circulating strains drives viral heterogeneity in Guangdong. These findings highlight the ongoing circulation and evolutionary complexity of DHBV in southern China and underscore the need for longitudinal genomic surveillance to detect emerging variants.

papers.title: Realizing personalized prediction for the reversal of chronic hepatitis B-associated liver fibrosis through machine learning
papers.abstract: Although long-term antiviral therapy can reverse liver fibrosis in a considerable proportion of patients with chronic hepatitis B, treatment response differs markedly among individuals, and reliable methods for predicting who will benefit remain lacking. Conventional clinical tools such as liver stiffness measurement and the aspartate aminotransferase-to-platelet ratio index were originally dewsigned for cross-sectional staging rather than longitudinal prediction, and their ability to capture the dynamic process of fibrosis reversal is limited. In this opinion review, we discuss how machine learning (ML) may help address this unmet need. We focus on three areas where ML has shown early but encouraging results: Quantitative analysis of images using ML, integration of pathological and clinical data through multimodal models, and dynamic prediction of treatment response based on serial measurements during antiviral therapy. In our view, the greatest value of ML lies not in replacing existing assessment tools but in complementing them, particularly through the early identification of patients who are unlikely to achieve fibrosis reversal with antiviral therapy alone. However, we also caution that most current models have been developed from small, single-center retrospective cohorts, and their clinical adoption will require prospective multi-center validation, improved model interpretability, and adherence to standardized reporting frameworks.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the potential of machine learning to address the challenge of predicting individual responses to antiviral therapy in chronic hepatitis B patients. The authors highlight three promising areas: image-based quantitative analysis, integration of clinical and pathological data through multimodal models, and dynamic prediction based on serial measurements. They emphasize that while ML shows early promise, its clinical adoption requires validation across larger, multi-center studies and improved model interpretability. The study underscores the importance of using ML to complement existing tools rather than replace them, offering a novel approach to personalized treatment strategies. However, the evidence is limited by the reliance on small, single-center datasets, which may restrict the generalizability of findings. The implications of this work suggest that ML could enhance the precision of predicting fibrosis reversal in chronic hepatitis B, contributing to more effective and individualized care.

papers.title: The long noncoding RNA MAPKAPK5-AS1 promotes the formation of hepatitis B virus cccDNA by modulating the expression of NABP1
papers.abstract: Cellular long noncoding RNAs (lncRNAs) have been shown to participate in diverse biological pathways, including the regulation of virus infections. However, their functions in the hepatitis B virus (HBV) life cycle still need to be explored. Here, we conducted a loss-of-function screen targeting 1779 human lncRNAs and identified 19 lncRNAs associated with HBV infection. One lncRNA, named MAPKAPK5-AS1 (lnc-MAAS), was identified as a host factor required for HBV infection. Our data suggest that lnc-MAAS is involved in the conversion of HBV relaxed circular DNA into covalently closed circular DNA (cccDNA). Furthermore, mechanistic experiments revealed that lnc-MAAS affects cccDNA formation by modulating the expression of nucleic acid binding protein 1 (NABP1). Together, our findings shed light on the roles of host lnc-MAAS and NABP1 in HBV cccDNA formation, which may contribute to the development of novel anti-HBV therapeutics.

analysis.methods: The study employed a loss-of-function screen to identify lncRNAs associated with HBV infection, followed by mechanistic experiments to elucidate the role of a specific lncRNA, lnc-MAAS, in cccDNA formation.
analysis.main_results: The study identified lnc-MAAS as a host factor required for HBV infection and found that it affects cccDNA formation by modulating the expression of NABP1.

elements_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to explore the role of host long noncoding RNAs (lncRNAs) in the hepatitis B virus (HBV) life cycle, addressing the need to understand the mechanisms underlying HBV infection and cccDNA formation.
elements_en.study_design_and_population: A loss-of-function screen targeting 1779 human lncRNAs was conducted to identify host factors involved in HBV infection, focusing on the HBV life cycle in human cells.
elements_en.methods: The study employed a loss-of-function screen to identify lncRNAs associated with HBV infection, followed by mechanistic experiments to elucidate the role of a specific lncRNA, lnc-MAAS, in cccDNA formation.
elements_en.main_results: The study identified lnc-MAAS as a host factor required for HBV infection and found that it affects cccDNA formation by modulating the expression of NABP1.
elements_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that lnc-MAAS plays a crucial role in HBV cccDNA formation through the regulation of NABP1 expression, providing new insights into the mechanisms of HBV infection and potentially contributing to the development of novel anti-HBV therapeutics.
elements_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study’s findings could inform the development of novel anti-HBV therapeutics by targeting lnc-MAAS and NABP1, which may help in the management of chronic hepatitis B and related complications.
elements_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s limitations include the use of a loss-of-function screen, which may not fully capture the complexity of the HBV life cycle, and the need for further validation of the findings in clinical settings.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨 宿主 长链非编码RNA(lncRNAs)在 乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)生命周期中的作用,以解决理解 HBV 感染机制和 共价闭合环状DNA 形成的必要性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 为了鉴定与 HBV 感染相关的 宿主 因子,对 1779 个人类 lncRNAs 进行了功能丧失筛选,重点关注人类细胞中 HBV 的生命周期。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究采用功能丧失筛选方法来鉴定与 HBV 感染相关的 lncRNAs,随后通过机制实验阐明特定 lncRNA lnc-MAAS 在 共价闭合环状DNA 形成中的作用。
elements_zh.main_results: 研究鉴定了 lnc-MAAS 作为 HBV 感染所需的 宿主 因子,并发现其通过调控 NABP1 的表达影响 共价闭合环状DNA 的形成。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,lnc-MAAS 通过调控 NABP1 表达在 HBV 共价闭合环状DNA 形成中起关键作用,为 HBV 感染机制提供了新的见解,并可能有助于开发新的抗 HBV 治疗药物。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 本研究的发现可能通过靶向 lnc-MAAS 和 NABP1 来指导新型抗 HBV 治疗药物的开发,这有助于管理 慢性乙型肝炎 及其相关并发症。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性包括使用功能丧失筛选方法,可能无法完全反映 HBV 生命周期的复杂性,以及需要在临床环境中进一步验证这些发现。}}.{

papers.title_zh: 长链非编码RNA MAPKAPK5-AS1 通过调控 NABP1 表达促进 乙型肝炎病毒 共价闭合环状DNA 的形成
papers.source_body_en: Cellular long noncoding RNAs (lncRNAs) have been shown to participate in diverse biological pathways, including the regulation of virus infections. However, their functions in the hepatitis B virus (HBV) life cycle still need to be explored. Here, we conducted a loss-of-function screen targeting 1779 human lncRNAs and identified 19 lncRNAs associated with HBV infection. One lncRNA, named MAPKAPK5-AS1 (lnc-MAAS), was identified as a host factor required for HBV infection. Our data suggest that lnc-MAAS is involved in the conversion of HBV relaxed circular DNA into covalently closed circular DNA (cccDNA). Furthermore, mechanistic experiments revealed that lnc-MAAS affects cccDNA formation by modulating the expression of nucleic acid binding protein 1 (NABP1). Together, our findings shed light on the roles of host lnc-MAAS and NABP1 in HBV cccDNA formation, which may contribute to the development of novel anti-HBV therapeutics.
papers.abstract_zh: 细胞内的长链非编码RNA(lncRNAs)已被证明参与多种生物途径,包括病毒感染的调控。然而,它们在 乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)生命周期中的功能仍需进一步探索。在这里,我们对 1779 个人类 lncRNAs 进行了功能丧失筛选,鉴定了 19 个与 HBV 感染相关的 lncRNAs。其中一种名为 MAPKAPK5-AS1(lnc-MAAS)的 lncRNA 被鉴定为 HBV 感染所需的 宿主 因子。我们的数据表明,lnc-MAAS 参与将 HBV 松弛环状DNA转化为共价闭合环状DNA(共价闭合环状DNA)的过程。此外,机制实验揭示了 lnc-MAAS 通过调控核苷酸结合蛋白 1(NABP1)的表达来影响 共价闭合环状DNA 的形成。综上所述,我们的发现阐明了 宿主 lnc-MAAS 和 NABP1 在 HBV 共价闭合环状DNA 形成中的作用,这可能有助于开发新的抗 HBV 治疗药物。

papers.title: Effect of Hepatitis B virus X T118N mutant protein in HepG2 cell cycle and apoptosis regulation
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) belongs to Hepadnaviridae family and caused liver infection. HBV infection can develop into hepatocellular carcinoma, one of which is due to presence of HBV X protein (HBx). Some mutations are known to be associated with development of liver carcinoma, for instance HBx K130M/V131I (HBx_KV). In Indonesia, HBx T118N (HBx_T) has been found at similar frequency as the HBx_KV. This study aims to examine the effect of HBx T118N mutant on cell cycle and apoptosis regulation. METHODS AND RESULTS: In this study, analysis of CyclinE, p21, Bax, and Bcl-2 gene expression was performed using RT-qPCR. Cell cycle and apoptosis analysis was done using flowcytometry with PI and Annexin V-PI staining, respectively. Caspase 3 activity assay was performed using CaspACETM Colorimetric Assay Kit. The presence of HBx_T mutant increased CyclinE expression at 72 h post transfection, similarly to HBx_KV. Both Bax and Bcl-2 mRNA level were also increased HepG2 cells expressing HBx_T in comparison to HBx_KV expression at 72 h post transfection. HBx_T expression in HepG2 cells at 48 h post transfection caused increase of AnnexinV+/PI- and AnnexinV+/PI+ cell populations, as compared to HBx_wt expression. CONCLUSIONS: Our data suggests that HBx_T influences cell cycle and apoptosis regulation in slightly different mechanism to HBx_KV. Further investigations are still required to understand HBx_T mutant involvement in development of chronic liver disease and liver cirrhosis.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to examine the effect of HBx T118N mutant on cell cycle and apoptosis regulation in HepG2 cells, addressing the need to understand the role of this specific HBV mutation in liver disease development.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study used HepG2 cells and analyzed the effect of HBx T118N mutant protein on cell cycle and apoptosis regulation through gene expression analysis and flow cytometry.
analysis.methods: The study employed RT-qPCR to analyze CyclinE, p21, Bax, and Bcl-2 gene expression, and flow cytometry with PI and Annexin V-PI staining to assess cell cycle and apoptosis. Caspase 3 activity was also measured using a colorimetric assay.
analysis.main_results: HBx T118N mutant increased CyclinE expression and Bax and Bcl-2 mRNA levels in HepG2 cells, and caused an increase in AnnexinV+/PI- and AnnexinV+/PI+ cell populations compared to HBx wild-type expression.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The data suggest that HBx T118N influences cell cycle and apoptosis regulation in a manner slightly different from HBx K130M/V131I, indicating potential differences in the mechanisms of liver disease development.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide insights into the role of HBx T118N in liver disease and suggest the need for further investigations to understand its involvement in chronic liver disease and liver cirrhosis.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by the use of a single cell line and the absence of in vivo studies, which may affect the generalizability of the findings. The evidence strength is moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This study examined the effect of HBx T118N mutant on cell cycle and apoptosis regulation in HepG2 cells, finding increased CyclinE expression and altered Bax and Bcl-2 mRNA levels, suggesting differences in liver disease mechanisms compared to HBx K130M/V131I.

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 数据表明,HBx T118N对细胞周期和凋亡调控的影响方式与HBx K130M/V131I略有不同,提示其在肝病发展中的机制可能存在差异。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为HBx T118N在肝病中的作用提供了见解,并表明需要进一步研究以了解其在慢性肝病和肝硬化发展中的参与情况。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于仅使用了一种细胞系,并且缺乏体内研究,这可能影响研究结果的普遍适用性。证据强度为中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)属于Hepadnaviridae科,可引起肝感染。HBV感染可发展为肝细胞癌,其中部分原因是由于HBV X蛋白(HBx)的存在。一些突变已被证实与肝癌的发生有关,例如HBx K130M/V131I(HBx_KV)。在印度尼西亚,HBx T118N(HBx_T)的出现频率与HBx_KV相似。本研究旨在探讨HBx_T突变蛋白对HepG2细胞周期和凋亡调控的影响。方法和结果:本研究使用RT-qPCR分析CyclinE、p21、Bax和Bcl-2基因的表达。细胞周期和凋亡分析通过流式细胞术进行,分别使用PI和Annexin V-PI染色。Caspase 3活性检测使用CaspACETM比色法试剂盒。HBx_T突变蛋白在转染后72小时增加了CyclinE的表达,与HBx_KV类似。在转染后72小时,与HBx_KV相比,表达HBx_T的HepG2细胞中Bax和Bcl-2 mRNA水平也有所增加。HBx_T在HepG2细胞中于转染后48小时表达时,导致AnnexinV+/PI-和AnnexinV+/PI+细胞群体的增加,与HBx野生型表达相比。结论:我们的数据表明,HBx_T对细胞周期和凋亡调控的影响机制与HBx_KV略有不同。仍需进一步研究以了解HBx_T突变在慢性肝病和肝硬化发展中的作用。

papers.title: Hepatic Steatosis in People With Chronic Hepatitis B in Africa: Prevalence, Correlates, and Clinical Significance.
papers.abstract: To address data gaps around metabolic liver disease in Africa, within the Hepatitis B in Africa Collaborative Network (HEPSANET), we evaluated participants with chronic hepatitis B virus infection (CHB) for steatotic liver disease (SLD) using transient elastography with controlled attenuation parameter (CAP). Using multivariable logistic regression, we identified sociodemographic, anthropometric, and clinical associations with SLD (CAP ≥ 248 dB/m), and evaluated whether SLD severity was independently associated with fibrosis. Short-term impacts of SLD on mortality were also assessed with Cox proportional hazards analysis. We also evaluated the diagnostic performance of B-mode ultrasound for SLD, with CAP as reference. Across 6 countries and 1601 participants (age range, 12-80 years; 39.5% female; 4% with diabetes; 11% unhealthy alcohol use; median body mass index, 24.4), 421 (26.3%) had SLD; 219 (13.7%) had severe steatosis (CAP ≥ 280 dB/m). Older age, male sex, overweight and obesity, and HIV-negative status were associated with SLD. After adjusting for age, sex, HIV status, HBV treatment, and country, severe steatosis, but not mild and moderate forms (i.e., 248-279 dB/m), was associated with a 8.4% (95%, 1.9%-14.9%) increased probability of fibrosis. Over limited follow-up (median 2.69 years) and small number of deaths, SLD was not associated with all-cause or liver-related mortality. B-mode ultrasound had low sensitivity for SLD, overall or when severe, but specificity was 95%. In conclusion, SLD was common in people with CHB in Africa and its severe form was associated with liver fibrosis. These data support screening for metabolic comorbidities as part of HBV care and treatment in Africa.
authors: Hepatitis B in Africa Collaborative Network (HEPSANET)

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to address data gaps on metabolic liver disease in Africa by evaluating participants with chronic hepatitis B virus infection for steatotic liver disease using transient elastography with controlled attenuation parameter (CAP). The research was conducted across six countries involving 1601 participants, with 421 (26.3%) found to have SLD and 219 (13.7%) with severe steatosis (CAP ≥ 280 dB/m). The study identified sociodemographic, anthropometric, and clinical factors associated with SLD, including older age, male sex, overweight and obesity, and HIV-negative status. After adjusting for various factors, severe steatosis was linked to an increased probability of fibrosis. However, SLD was not associated with mortality during limited follow-up. The findings highlight the importance of screening for metabolic comorbidities in HBV care and suggest that severe steatosis may be a marker for fibrosis. The study's limitations include its short follow-up period and small number of deaths, which may affect the strength of conclusions about mortality.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 为了解决非洲地区代谢性肝病的数据缺口,我们在非洲乙型肝炎合作网络(HEPSANET)中评估了慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)患者是否患有脂肪性肝病(SLD),使用了瞬时弹性成像结合控制衰减参数(CAP).
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 通过多变量逻辑回归分析,我们确定了与SLD(CAP ≥ 248 dB/m)相关的社会人口学、人体测量学和临床特征,并评估了SLD严重程度是否独立与纤维化相关.
elements_zh.methods: 在6个国家的1601名参与者(年龄范围12-80岁;39.5%女性;4%患有糖尿病;11%有不健康饮酒行为;中位数体重指数24.4)中,421名(26.3%)患有SLD;219名(13.7%)患有严重脂肪变(CAP ≥ 280 dB/m).
elements_zh.main_results: 年龄较大、男性性别、超重和肥胖以及HIV阴性状态与SLD相关。在调整年龄、性别、HIV状态、HBV 治疗和国家后,严重脂肪变(而非轻度和中度形式,即248-279 dB/m)与纤维化概率增加8.4%(95%置信区间1.9%-14.9%)相关.
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 总之,SLD在非洲CHB患者中较为常见,其严重形式与肝纤维化相关。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些数据支持将代谢合并症筛查作为非洲 HBV 护理和 治疗 的一部分。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 在有限的随访时间(中位数2.69年)和较少的死亡病例下,SLD与全因或肝相关死亡率无显著关联。

papers.title_zh: 非洲 慢性乙型肝炎 患者的肝脂肪变性:患病率、相关性和临床意义。
papers.source_body_en: To address data gaps around metabolic liver disease in Africa, within the Hepatitis B in Africa Collaborative Network (HEPSANET), we evaluated participants with chronic hepatitis B virus infection (CHB) for steatotic liver disease (SLD) using transient elastography with controlled attenuation parameter (CAP). Using multivariable logistic regression, we identified sociodemographic, anthropometric, and clinical associations with SLD (CAP ≥ 248 dB/m), and evaluated whether SLD severity was independently associated with fibrosis. Short-term impacts of SLD on mortality were also assessed with Cox proportional hazards analysis. We also evaluated the diagnostic performance of B-mode ultrasound for SLD, with CAP as reference. Across 6 countries and 1601 participants (age range, 12-80 years; 39.5% female; 4% with diabetes; 11% unhealthy alcohol use; median body mass index, 24.4), 421 (26.3%) had SLD; 219 (13.7%) had severe steatosis (CAP ≥ 280 dB/m). Older age, male sex, overweight and obesity, and HIV-negative status were associated with SLD. After adjusting for age, sex, HIV status, HBV treatment, and country, severe steatosis, but not mild and moderate forms (i.e., 248-279 dB/m), was associated with a 8.4% (95%, 1.9%-14.9%) increased probability of fibrosis. Over limited follow-up (median 2.69 years) and small number of deaths, SLD was not associated with all-cause or liver-related mortality. B-mode ultrasound had low sensitivity for SLD, overall or when severe, but specificity was 95%. In conclusion, SLD was common in people with CHB in Africa and its severe form was associated with liver fibrosis. These data support screening for metabolic comorbidities as part of HBV care and treatment in Africa.
papers.abstract_zh: 为了解决非洲地区代谢性肝病的数据缺口,我们在非洲乙型肝炎合作网络(HEPSANET)中评估了慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)患者是否患有脂肪性肝病(SLD),使用了瞬时弹性成像结合控制衰减参数(CAP)。通过多变量逻辑回归分析,我们确定了与SLD(CAP ≥ 248 dB/m)相关的社会人口学、人体测量学和临床特征,并评估了SLD严重程度是否独立与纤维化相关。我们还使用Cox比例风险模型评估了SLD对死亡率的短期影响。此外,我们评估了B型超声波在SLD诊断中的表现,以CAP为参考标准。在6个国家的1601名参与者(年龄范围12-80岁;39.5%女性;4%患有糖尿病;11%有不健康饮酒行为;中位数体重指数24.4)中,421名(26.3%)患有SLD;219名(13.7%)患有严重脂肪变(CAP ≥ 280 dB/m)。年龄较大、男性性别、超重和肥胖以及HIV阴性状态与SLD相关。在调整年龄、性别、HIV状态、HBV 治疗和国家后,严重脂肪变(而非轻度和中度形式,即248-279 dB/m)与纤维化概率增加8.4%(95%置信区间1.9%-14.9%)相关。在有限的随访时间(中位数2.69年)和较少的死亡病例下,SLD与全因或肝相关死亡率无显著关联。B型超声波对SLD的敏感性较低,无论是整体还是在严重情况下,但特异性为95%。总之,SLD在非洲CHB患者中较为常见,其严重形式与肝纤维化相关。这些数据支持在非洲HBV管理中纳入代谢性共病的筛查措施以及治疗的监测。

papers.title: Ultrasound findings across liver fibrosis stages defined by transient elastography in patients with chronic hepatitis B in Georgia
papers.abstract: PURPOSE: Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) remains a major cause of chronic liver disease and may progress to liver fibrosis, cirrhosis, and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). This study aimed to evaluate conventional abdominal ultrasound (US) findings across liver fibrosis stages defined by transient elastography (TE) in patients with CHB. METHODS: In this cross-sectional study, 232 adults with CHB were included. Conventional abdominal US and TE data were available for 231 patients. US findings were evaluated in relation to liver fibrosis stages defined by TE-derived liver stiffness measurements. Differences in liver stiffness according to US findings were assessed using the independent-samples t-test. RESULTS: Patients with heterogeneous liver echotexture had significantly higher liver stiffness than those with normal liver echotexture (8.71 ± 6.89 vs. 5.65 ± 1.30 kPa; mean difference, 3.06 kPa; 95% CI 1.78-4.34 kPa; p < 0.001). Patients with splenomegaly had significantly higher liver stiffness than those without splenomegaly (17.31 ± 15.18 vs. 6.55 ± 2.82 kPa; mean difference, 10.77 kPa; 95% CI 2.00-19.54 kPa; p = 0.020). Among the 231 patients, 71.9% were classified as F0-F1, 21.6% as F2-F3, and 6.5% as F4. Four patients were diagnosed with HCC, including three with cirrhosis (F4) and one with F0-F1 fibrosis. CONCLUSIONS: Conventional abdominal US findings, particularly heterogeneous liver echotexture and splenomegaly, were associated with higher liver stiffness in patients with CHB. These findings support the complementary role of conventional abdominal US in the comprehensive non-invasive evaluation of patients with CHB.

papers.title: Becoming Physically Active and Risks of Mortality and Liver-Related Events in Adults With Chronic Hepatitis B: A Nationwide Cohort Study.
papers.abstract: Physical activity (PA) confers several health benefits; however, whether increasing PA among physically inactive adults with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) is associated with lower risks of adverse clinical outcomes remains unclear. We used the nationwide Korean National Health Insurance database. We included 318,131 adults with CHB who were physically inactive at the initial health screening (Exam 1) and completed a subsequent screening within 4 years (Exam 2). Among them, 58,703 initiated moderate-to-vigorous PA (MVPA), defined as vigorous activity ≥ 20 min/day on ≥ 3 days/week or moderate activity ≥ 30 min/day on ≥ 5 days/week. The primary outcome was all-cause mortality, and the secondary outcomes were liver-related events (hepatic decompensation, liver transplantation, hepatocellular carcinoma [HCC]) and HCC. Multivariable Cox and Fine-Grey competing-risk models were adjusted for demographic, clinical, and behavioural factors. During a median 7.9-year follow-up (IQR, 5.2-9.5), 7609 deaths occurred. MVPA initiation was associated with lower all-cause mortality (hazard ratio [HR], 0.89; 95% CI, 0.84-0.94), a lower risk of liver-related events (subdistribution HR [subHR], 0.94; 95% CI, 0.92-0.97), and, more modestly, of HCC (subHR, 0.95; 95% CI, 0.91-0.99) compared with those remaining inactive. The association was more pronounced in older adults, women, never smokers, non-drinkers, and untreated participants (all p for interaction ≤ 0.03). Initiating MVPA among physically inactive adults with CHB was associated with lower risks of mortality and liver-related outcomes. These findings provide large-scale epidemiological evidence supporting further evaluation of PA promotion in physically inactive patients with CHB.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the association between initiating moderate-to-vigorous physical activity (MVPA) and reduced risks of mortality and liver-related events in adults with chronic hepatitis B (CHB). Using the nationwide Korean National Health Insurance database, the researchers followed 318,131 physically inactive adults with CHB over a median of 7.9 years. They found that MVPA initiation was linked to lower all-cause mortality (HR, 0.89; 95% CI, 0.84-0.94), reduced liver-related events (subHR, 0.94; 95% CI, 0.92-0.97), and a modest decrease in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) risk (subHR, 0.95; 95% CI, 0.91-0.99) compared to those who remained inactive. The associations were stronger in specific subgroups, including older adults, women, and untreated participants. The study highlights the potential public health significance of promoting physical activity in CHB patients, though it does not provide direct causal evidence.

papers.title: Risk factors for postpartum alanine aminotransferase elevation in women with chronic hepatitis B infection: a systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.abstract: Background Postpartum alanine aminotransferase (ALT) elevation is common in women with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) infection and may adversely affect maternal recovery and long-term disease outcomes. However, the risk factors associated with postpartum ALT elevation remain inconsistent across studies. Methods We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis in accordance with the PRISMA guidelines; the registration number is CRD420251208005. PubMed, Web of Science, Embase, Cochrane Library, China National Knowledge Infrastructure (CNKI), and WanFang databases were searched from their inception to 1 January 2026. Results A total of 17 cohort studies involving 6,876 women with CHB were included. The meta-analysis demonstrated that hepatitis B e-antigen (HBeAg) positivity (odds ratio [OR] = 3.03; 95% CI [1.91–4.81]), higher baseline hepatitis B virus (HBV) DNA levels (OR = 1.39; 95% CI [1.04–1.86]), and elevated antepartum ALT levels were significantly associated with postpartum ALT elevation. A subgroup analysis revealed that antepartum ALT elevation, defined as a categorical variable (ALT >1 ULN), showed a strong association with postpartum ALT elevation (OR = 5.54, 95% CI 3.78–8.12), whereas continuous ALT increase showed a smaller effect size. Increasing maternal age was associated with a reduced risk of postpartum ALT elevation (OR = 0.93, 95% CI 0.87–0.99). Conclusion HBeAg positivity, high baseline HBV DNA levels, and elevated antepartum ALT levels are key risk factors for postpartum ALT elevation in women with CHB. Additionally, younger maternal age may confer increased susceptibility. Systematic review registration https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/view/CRD420251208005 , Identifier: CRD420251208005.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to identify risk factors for postpartum alanine aminotransferase (ALT) elevation in women with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) infection. The study included 17 cohort studies involving 6,876 women with CHB. Key findings indicated that HBeAg positivity, higher baseline HBV DNA levels, and elevated antepartum ALT levels were significantly associated with postpartum ALT elevation. Subgroup analysis showed that antepartum ALT elevation, defined as ALT >1 ULN, had a strong association with postpartum ALT elevation, while continuous ALT increase showed a smaller effect. Increasing maternal age was associated with a reduced risk of postpartum ALT elevation. The review highlights the importance of monitoring antepartum ALT levels and managing HBeAg positivity and HBV DNA levels in women with CHB during pregnancy and postpartum periods. The findings suggest that younger maternal age may increase susceptibility to postpartum ALT elevation.

papers.source_body_en: Background Postpartum alanine aminotransferase (ALT) elevation is common in women with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) infection and may adversely affect maternal recovery and long-term disease outcomes. However, the risk factors associated with postpartum ALT elevation remain inconsistent across studies. Methods We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis in accordance with the PRISMA guidelines; the registration number is CRD420251208005. PubMed, Web of Science, Embase, Cochrane Library, China National Knowledge Infrastructure (CNKI), and WanFang databases were searched from their inception to 1 January 2026. Results A total of 17 cohort studies involving 6,876 women with CHB were included. The meta-analysis demonstrated that hepatitis B e-antigen (HBeAg) positivity (odds ratio [OR] = 3.03; 95% CI [1.91–4.81]), higher baseline hepatitis B virus (HBV) DNA levels (OR = 1.39; 95% CI [1.04–1.86]), and elevated antepartum ALT levels were significantly associated with postpartum ALT elevation. A subgroup analysis revealed that antepartum ALT elevation, defined as a categorical variable (ALT >1 ULN), showed a strong association with postpartum ALT elevation (OR = 5.54, 95% CI 3.78–8.12), whereas continuous ALT increase showed a smaller effect size. Increasing maternal age was associated with a reduced risk of postpartum ALT elevation (OR = 0.93, 95% CI 0.87–0.99). Conclusion HBeAg positivity, high baseline HBV DNA levels, and elevated antepartum ALT levels are key risk factors for postpartum ALT elevation in women with CHB. Additionally, younger maternal age may confer increased susceptibility. Systematic review registration https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/view/CRD420251208005 , Identifier: CRD420251208005.

papers.title: A comprehensive evaluation on the impact of MASLD on the prognosis of chronic hepatitis B-related hepatocellular carcinoma following hepatectomy: results from retrospective multicenter cohort study and meta-analysis
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Prognosis after radical hepatectomy for chronic hepatitis B (CHB) related hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is poor. Comorbidity of CHB and metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) has grown increasingly common, with MASLD further modifying the hepatic microenvironment beyond HBV-induced injury. However, its impact on postoperative prognosis remains unclear. METHODS: Combining a retrospective study with meta-analysis, this study systematically compared prognostic differences and influencing factors in 424 hepatectomy patients (MASLD-CHB-HCC group vs. CHB-HCC group) from multiple centers. Additionally, a meta-analysis involving 6653 patients was performed to further verify the prognostic effect of MASLD. RESULTS: In this retrospective cohort study, the MASLD-CHB-HCC group showed significantly superior overall survival (OS) (p = 0.041) and recurrence-free survival (RFS) (p = 0.028) compared with the CHB-HCC group, with statistically significant differences. However, after performing propensity score matching (PSM) screening, no statistical differences were observed in OS (p = 0.220) and RFS (p = 0.190) between the two groups. This result is consistent with our meta-analysis conclusion. Cox regression analysis demonstrated that higher body mass index (BMI) was an independent factor associated with favorable survival. In subgroup analyses stratified by different BMI cutoffs, among non-lean patients, the MASLD-CHB-HCC group achieved better OS (BMI ≥ 23 subgroup: p < 0.001; BMI ≥ 25 subgroup: p < 0.001) and RFS (BMI ≥ 23 subgroup: p < 0.001; BMI ≥ 25 subgroup: p < 0.001). CONCLUSIONS: MASLD exerts differential impacts on survival prognosis in patients with CHB-HCC, with divergent effects observed between lean and non-lean subgroups stratified by BMI.

analysis.scope_and_question: This study evaluates the impact of MASLD on the prognosis of chronic hepatitis B-related hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) following hepatectomy. The central question is whether MASLD modifies postoperative outcomes in patients with CHB-HCC.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The study combines a retrospective multicenter cohort study with a meta-analysis. It included 424 patients from multiple centers and a meta-analysis involving 6653 patients. Propensity score matching (PSM) was used to adjust for confounding factors, and Cox regression analysis was performed to identify independent prognostic factors.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The study found that the MASLD-CHB-HCC group showed significantly better overall survival (OS) and recurrence-free survival (RFS) compared to the CHB-HCC group in the retrospective cohort study. However, after PSM, no significant differences were observed. Subgroup analyses revealed that among non-lean patients, the MASLD-CHB-HCC group had better OS and RFS, particularly in BMI ≥ 23 and BMI ≥ 25 subgroups. The meta-analysis confirmed these findings, indicating that MASLD has differential impacts on survival prognosis in CHB-HCC patients.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The study highlights conflicting findings between the initial analysis and the PSM-adjusted results, suggesting potential confounding factors. Additionally, the differential effects of MASLD on survival were observed only in non-lean subgroups, indicating a need for further research to understand the mechanisms behind these differences.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Future research should focus on understanding the mechanisms by which MASLD affects survival in CHB-HCC patients, particularly in non-lean subgroups. There is a need for larger, prospective studies to validate these findings and explore the role of BMI in mediating the impact of MASLD on prognosis.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the impact of MASLD on the prognosis of chronic hepatitis B-related hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) following hepatectomy. A retrospective multicenter cohort study and meta-analysis were conducted, involving 424 and 6653 patients, respectively. Initial findings suggested that MASLD-CHB-HCC patients had better overall survival (OS) and recurrence-free survival (RFS) compared to CHB-HCC patients, but these differences disappeared after propensity score matching (PSM). Subgroup analyses revealed that non-lean patients with MASLD-CHB-HCC had significantly improved OS and RFS, particularly in BMI ≥ 23 and ≥ 25 groups. The meta-analysis supported these results, indicating that MASLD has differential effects on survival outcomes in CHB-HCC patients. The study underscores the need for further research to clarify the mechanisms behind these differences and to explore the role of BMI in influencing prognosis.

analysis_en.scope_and_question: This study evaluates the impact of MASLD on the prognosis of chronic hepatitis B-related hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) following hepatectomy. The central question is whether MASLD modifies postoperative outcomes in patients with CHB-HCC.
analysis_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: The study combines a retrospective multicenter cohort study with a meta-analysis. It included 424 patients from multiple centers and a meta-analysis involving 6653 patients. Propensity score matching (PSM) was used to adjust for confounding factors, and Cox regression analysis was performed to identify independent prognostic factors.
analysis_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The study found that the MASLD-CHB-HCC group showed significantly better overall survival (OS) and recurrence-free survival (RFS) compared to the CHB-HCC group in the retrospective cohort study. However, after PSM, no significant differences were observed. Subgroup analyses revealed that among non-lean patients, the MASLD-CHB-HCC group had better OS and RFS, particularly in BMI ≥ 23 and BMI ≥ 25 subgroups. The meta-analysis confirmed these findings, indicating that MASLD has differential impacts on survival prognosis in CHB-HCC patients.
analysis_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The study highlights conflicting findings between the initial analysis and the PSM-adjusted results, suggesting potential confounding factors. Additionally, the differential effects of MASLD on survival were observed only in non-lean subgroups, indicating a need for further research to understand the mechanisms behind these differences.
analysis_en.research_and_practice_implications: Future research should focus on understanding the mechanisms by which MASLD affects survival in CHB-HCC patients, particularly in non-lean subgroups. There is a need for larger, prospective studies to validate these findings and explore the role of BMI in mediating the impact of MASLD on prognosis.

papers.title_zh: MASLD对慢性乙型肝炎相关肝细胞癌肝切除术后预后影响的综合评估:来自回顾性多中心队列研究研究和荟萃分析的结果
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Prognosis after radical hepatectomy for chronic hepatitis B (CHB) related hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is poor. Comorbidity of CHB and metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) has grown increasingly common, with MASLD further modifying the hepatic microenvironment beyond HBV-induced injury. However, its impact on postoperative prognosis remains unclear. METHODS: Combining a retrospective study with meta-analysis, this study systematically compared prognostic differences and influencing factors in 424 hepatectomy patients (MASLD-CHB-HCC group vs. CHB-HCC group) from multiple centers. Additionally, a meta-analysis involving 6653 patients was performed to further verify the prognostic effect of MASLD. RESULTS: In this retrospective cohort study, the MASLD-CHB-HCC group showed significantly superior overall survival (OS) (p = 0.041) and recurrence-free survival (RFS) (p = 0.028) compared with the CHB-HCC group, with statistically significant differences. However, after performing propensity score matching (PSM) screening, no statistical differences were observed in OS (p = 0.220) and RFS (p = 0.190) between the two groups. This result is consistent with our meta-analysis conclusion. Cox regression analysis demonstrated that higher body mass index (BMI) was an independent factor associated with favorable survival. In subgroup analyses stratified by different BMI cutoffs, among non-lean patients, the MASLD-CHB-HCC group achieved better OS (BMI ≥ 23 subgroup: p < 0.001; BMI ≥ 25 subgroup: p < 0.001) and RFS (BMI ≥ 23 subgroup: p < 0.001; BMI ≥ 25 subgroup: p < 0.001). CONCLUSIONS: MASLD exerts differential impacts on survival prognosis in patients with CHB-HCC, with divergent effects observed between lean and non-lean subgroups stratified by BMI.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)相关肝细胞癌(HCC)患者在进行根治性肝切除术后预后较差。CHB与代谢相关脂肪性肝病(MASLD)的共病现象日益普遍,MASLD进一步改变了HBV诱导的肝微环境。然而,其对术后预后的影响尚不明确。方法:本研究结合回顾性研究与荟萃分析,系统比较了来自多中心的424例肝切除患者(MASLD-CHB-HCC组与CHB-HCC组)的预后差异及影响因素。此外,还进行了包含6653例患者的荟萃分析,以进一步验证MASLD的预后效应。结果:在本回顾性队列研究研究中,MASLD-CHB-HCC组的总体生存率(OS)(p = 0.041)和无复发生存率(RFS)(p = 0.028)显著优于CHB-HCC组,差异具有统计学意义。然而,在进行倾向评分匹配(PSM)筛选后,两组之间的OS(p = 0.220)和RFS(p = 0.190)无显著统计学差异。这一结果与我们的荟萃分析结论一致。Cox回归分析显示,较高的身体质量指数(BMI)是与良好生存相关的独立因素。在按不同BMI截断值分层的亚组分析中,对于非瘦体型患者,MASLD-CHB-HCC组在OS(BMI ≥ 23亚组:p < 0.001;BMI ≥ 25亚组:p < 0.001)和RFS(BMI ≥ 23亚组:p < 0.001;BMI ≥ 25亚组:p < 0.001)方面均表现更好。结论:MASLD对CHB-HCC患者的生存预后具有差异性影响,在按BMI分层的瘦体型和非瘦体型亚组中观察到不同的效果。

papers.title: Concomitant Liver Steatosis in Chronic Hepatitis B Virus Infection Is Linked to a Distinct Cytokine Profile and Reduced Viral Load.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection frequently coexists with hepatic steatosis, which may promote liver disease progression and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) development. However, the effects of liver steatosis on antiviral immune responses and viral load remain incompletely understood. METHODS: We investigated cytokine and chemokine patterns in plasma samples of 66 treatment-naive patients with chronic HBV infection in the absence or presence of liver steatosis. In addition, viral load and aminotransferase levels were assessed in blood samples. RESULTS: Patients with HBV infection and liver steatosis revealed a lower viral load than patients without liver steatosis. Despite a reduced viral load, liver steatosis was associated with reduced plasma levels of several cytokines and chemokines including interleukin (IL)-2, IL-9, IL-15, IL-18, CCL2, CCL4, and CXCL10, as well as with reduced aminotransferase levels. In contrast, other cytokines, such as IL-4, IL-5, IL-6, IL-7, IL-8, IL-10, IL-12, IL-17, and tumor necrosis factor-α, did not significantly differ between the two patient groups. CONCLUSIONS: In chronic HBV infection, concomitant liver steatosis is associated with lower viral load but a dampened systemic cytokine and chemokine response suggesting an impaired immune response that may influence disease progression and HCC risk independently of viral load.

source_records.abstract: BACKGROUND: Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection frequently coexists with hepatic steatosis, which may promote liver disease progression and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) development. However, the effects of liver steatosis on antiviral immune responses and viral load remain incompletely understood. METHODS: We investigated cytokine and chemokine patterns in plasma samples of 66 treatment-naive patients with chronic HBV infection in the absence or presence of liver steatosis. In addition, viral load and aminotransferase levels were assessed in blood samples. RESULTS: Patients with HBV infection and liver steatosis revealed a lower viral load than patients without liver steatosis. Despite a reduced viral load, liver steatosis was associated with reduced plasma levels of several cytokines and chemokines including interleukin (IL)-2, IL-9, IL-15, IL-18, CCL2, CCL4, and CXCL10, as well as with reduced aminotransferase levels. In contrast, other cytokines, such as IL-4, IL-5, IL-6, IL-7, IL-8, IL-10, IL-12, IL-17, and tumor necrosis factor-α, did not significantly differ between the two patient groups. CONCLUSIONS: In chronic HBV infection, concomitant liver steatosis is associated with lower viral load but a dampened systemic cytokine and chemokine response suggesting an impaired immune response that may influence disease progression and HCC risk independently of viral load.

papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection frequently coexists with hepatic steatosis, which may promote liver disease progression and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) development. papers.abstract_zh: 背景:慢性乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)感染常与肝脂肪变并存,这可能促进肝病进展和肝细胞癌(HCC)的发生。然而,肝脂肪变对抗病毒药物 免疫应答及病毒载量的影响仍不完全清楚。方法:我们研究了66名慢性HBV感染且未接受治疗治疗的患者在存在或不存在肝脂肪变情况下的血浆样本中的细胞因子和趋化因子模式,并评估了血液样本中的病毒载量和氨基转移酶水平。结果:HBV感染合并肝脂肪变的患者表现出比无肝脂肪变的患者更低的病毒载量。尽管病毒载量降低,肝脂肪变与几种细胞因子和趋化因子的血浆水平降低相关,包括白细胞介素(IL)-2、IL-9、IL-15、IL-18、CCL2、CCL4和CXCL10,以及与氨基转移酶水平降低相关。相反,其他细胞因子,如IL-4、IL-5、IL-6、IL-7、IL-8、IL-10、IL-12、IL-17和肿瘤坏死因子-α,在两组患者之间没有显著差异。结论:在慢性HBV感染中,肝脂肪变与较低的病毒载量相关,但与系统性细胞因子和趋化因子反应减弱有关,这表明免疫应答可能受损,这种损害可能独立于病毒载量影响疾病进展和HCC风险。

papers.title: Prevalence and determinants of hepatitis B vaccination uptake among pregnant women in sub-Saharan Africa: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVE: Despite more than two decades of hepatitis B vaccination implementation across sub-Saharan Africa (SSA), hepatitis B virus (HBV) remains hyperendemic in the region, with vertical transmission an important route of infection. However, there is a lack of regional evidence on HBV vaccination uptake among pregnant women, a priority population in HBV prevention. This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to estimate the prevalence of HBV vaccination uptake and identify its determinants among pregnant women in SSA. DESIGN: Systematic review and random-effects meta-analysis conducted in accordance with the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) guidelines. DATA SOURCES: Following prospective registration (PROSPERO), we searched MEDLINE, Embase, Web of Science and Scopus for peer-reviewed studies published up to August 2026, supplemented by African Journals Online and Google Scholar. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA FOR SELECTING STUDIES: Observational studies reporting HBV vaccination uptake among pregnant women in SSA countries were included. DATA EXTRACTION AND SYNTHESIS: Two reviewers independently screened studies, extracted data and assessed methodological quality using the Joanna Briggs Institute checklist for analytical cross-sectional studies. A random-effects meta-analysis was performed to estimate pooled prevalence. Subgroup and meta-regression sensitivity analyses explored sources of heterogeneity and robustness of findings. Determinants of vaccination uptake were synthesised narratively. RESULTS: Of 1041 records screened, 21 studies involving 15 804 pregnant women from seven SSA countries were included. The pooled prevalence of HBV vaccination uptake was 18% (95% CI 14% to 21%) with substantial heterogeneity (I2=99.2%) observed. Studies from West Africa (12; n=8062) reported higher vaccine uptake (24%, 95% CI 17% to 31%; p<0.001). Available studies identified socioeconomic, behavioural and healthcare-related factors associated with uptake, though evidence was limited. Evidence of small-study effects or potential publication bias was observed (Egger’s test, p<0.001). The overall certainty of evidence was considered very low using the Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation (GRADE) approach, reflecting serious concerns regarding inconsistency, risk of bias and small-study effects. CONCLUSIONS: HBV vaccination uptake among pregnant women in SSA remains suboptimal and represents an important unmet need for preventing vertical transmission. Targeted, context-specific interventions to improve awareness, access and integration of vaccination into antenatal care services are needed to enhance uptake. Future research should examine barriers and evaluate interventions to increase vaccination coverage in this priority population. PROSPERO REGISTRATION NUMBER: CRD420251120357.

papers.abstract_zh: OBJECTIVE: 尽管撒哈拉以南非洲(SSA)地区已实施乙型肝炎病毒疫苗接种超过二十年,乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)仍在此地区高度流行,垂直传播是重要的感染途径。然而,关于孕妇中HBV疫苗接种接受情况的区域证据仍然缺乏,孕妇是HBV预防的重点人群。本系统综述和元分析旨在估计HBV疫苗接种接受情况的总体水平,并确定撒哈拉以南非洲孕妇中该疫苗接种的决定因素。DESIGN: 本研究遵循首选报告项目清单(PRISMA)指南进行系统综述和随机效应元分析。DATA SOURCES: 在前瞻性注册(PROSPERO)后,我们搜索了MEDLINE、Embase、Web of Science和Scopus数据库,获取截至2026年8月发表的同行评审研究,并补充了非洲期刊在线和Google Scholar。ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA FOR SELECTING STUDIES: 包括报告撒哈拉以南非洲国家孕妇中HBV疫苗接种接受情况的观察性研究。DATA EXTRACTION AND SYNTHESIS: 两名评审员独立筛选研究、提取数据并使用Joanna Briggs研究所的分析横断面研究检查表评估方法学质量。采用随机效应元分析来估计总体接受情况。亚组分析和元回归敏感性分析用于探索异质性的来源和结果的稳健性。疫苗接种接受情况的决定因素通过叙述性综合进行分析。RESULTS: 在筛选的1041条记录中,纳入了来自七个撒哈拉以南非洲国家、涉及15,804名孕妇的21项研究。HBV疫苗接种的总体接受率为18%(95% CI 14%至21%),观察到显著的异质性(I2=99.2%)。西非的研究(12项;n=8062)报告了更高的疫苗接种接受率(24%,95% CI 17%至31%;p<0.001)。现有研究确定了与疫苗接种接受相关的社会经济、行为和医疗保健因素,但证据有限。观察到小研究效应或潜在发表偏倚的证据(Egger’s检验,p<0.001)。使用推荐评估、发展和评价(GRADE)方法评估证据的整体确定性,认为其非常低,反映了对不一致性、偏倚风险和小研究效应的严重关注。CONCLUSIONS: 撒哈拉以南非洲孕妇中HBV疫苗接种接受情况仍然不足,是预防垂直传播的重要未满足需求。需要有针对性、因地制宜的干预措施,以提高意识、获取和将疫苗接种纳入产前护理服务,从而提高接种率。未来的研究应探讨障碍并评估干预措施,以增加该重点人群的疫苗接种覆盖率。PROSPERO REGISTRATION NUMBER: CRD420251120357.

This important achievement was validated by the European Technical Advisory Group of Experts on Immunization (ETAGE), following an assessment of country reports and recommendations from the ETAGE Working Group on Hepatitis B at its sixth meeting on 10 April 2026. Hepatitis B can cause lifelong infection and serious complications, including cirrhosis and liver cancer. Preventing infection early in life is therefore critical. Through high vaccination coverage and measures to prevent transmission from mother to child, including timely birth-dose vaccination, Albania and Armenia are protecting children from the long-term consequences of the virus. Country serosurveys showed that more than 20 years of sustained hepatitis B vaccination has led to the elimination of hepatitis B among children aged 6–8 years. No children tested positive for the hepatitis B virus surface antigen, corresponding to an estimated prevalence of 0%. Marking an important milestone On 6 October 2026, the WHO Country Office in Armenia held a ceremony to mark the handover of the certificate of validation of hepatitis B control targets to Ms Anahit Avanesyan, Minister of Health of the Republic of Armenia. Caption: From left to right: Françoise Jacob, UN Resident Coordinator in Armenia; Anahit Avanesyan, Minister of Health of Armenia; Dr Siddhartha Datta, WHO Representative in Armenia; and Ghassan Khalil, UNICEF Representative in Armenia. Credit: WHO. Albania and Armenia join Belarus, Georgia, Italy, Kyrgyzstan, the Netherlands (Kingdom of the), the Republic of Moldova, Turkmenistan, the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland, and Uzbekistan, which had previously been validated as reaching the hepatitis B control targets in 2021–2023. WHO applauds the commitment and dedication of immunization programmes in all countries to achieve a high level of protection from hepatitis B and its long-term consequences in their populations born after the introduction of universal hepatitis B vaccination. Countries use different strategies for vaccination and the prevention of perinatal transmission of hepatitis B based on their national context and are supported by WHO/Europe in validating the achievement of the control targets. Each country that reaches these targets represents progress not only in preventing hepatitis B infections but also in reducing the number of people and families affected by liver disease and liver cancer. Together, these achievements bring the WHO European Region closer to the goal of eliminating viral hepatitis as a public health threat by 2030. news.content_zh: 阿尔巴尼亚和亚美尼亚已实现乙肝控制目标,标志着世界卫生组织欧洲区域消除病毒工作的重要里程碑。这一成就经由欧洲免疫技术专家顾问小组(ETAGE)验证,该验证是在其第六次会议上(2026年4月10日)评估了国家报告并采纳了乙肝技术工作组的建议后进行的。国家血清学调查表明,超过20年的持续疫苗接种努力已使6至8岁儿童群体中实现乙肝病毒的消除,未检测到任何阳性病例。验证仪式于2026年10月6日举行,将验证证书颁发给亚美尼亚卫生部长。乙肝病毒可导致终身感染及严重并发症,如肝硬化和肝癌,因此早期预防至关重要。这一成就与其他已实现类似目标的WHO欧洲区域国家并列,突显了公共卫生举措的进展。

news.wechat_summary_zh: 时间：该里程碑于2026年实现，验证仪式于2026年10月6日举行。发布日期为2026年10月12日。；地点与对象：阿尔巴尼亚和亚美尼亚，重点关注6至8岁儿童群体。；事件：阿尔巴尼亚和亚美尼亚实现了乙肝控制目标，该目标经欧洲免疫技术专家顾问小组(ETAGE)验证，验证是在其第六次会议(2026年4月10日)上评估国家报告并采纳乙肝技术工作组建议后进行的。；影响与风险：国家血清学调查显示，超过20年的持续疫苗接种努力使6至8岁儿童群体中实现乙肝病毒的消除，未检测到任何儿童的乙型肝炎病毒表面抗原阳性，对应估计的患病率为0%。乙肝病毒可导致终身感染及严重并发症，包括肝硬化和肝癌。；应对与不确定性：该成就经ETAGE验证，验证证书已颁发给亚美尼亚卫生部长。该里程碑是世界卫生组织欧洲区域消除乙肝病毒工作的一部分。

news.title: Tislelizumab-induced immune-mediated hepatotoxicity combined with two episodes of hepatitis B virus reactivation: a case report - Frontiers
news.rss_summary_html: Tislelizumab-induced immune-mediated hepatotoxicity combined with two episodes of hepatitis B virus reactivation: a case report  Frontiers
retrieval_queries: "Hepatitis B virus" HBV DNA Quantification Case 2022
news.excerpt_original: Tislelizumab-induced immune-mediated hepatotoxicity combined with two episodes of hepatitis B virus reactivation: a case report Frontiers
